findings.current: La vista Documentos muestra en pestañas todas tus notas, artículos de blog, código y visualizaciones abiertas.
findings.proposed: La vista Documentos muestra en pestañas todas tus notas, artículos de blog, código y visualizaciones abiertos.
findings.reason: The postponed adjective modifies a mixed-gender coordination, which Spanish requires in the masculine plural; as written 'abiertas' attaches only to 'visualizaciones', narrowing English 'all your open notes, blog articles, code, and visualizations' to just the open visualizations.

findings.current: …se incluyen como rutas de archivo de tu equipo… / …Todos los archivos que creen tus agentes en tu equipo…
findings.proposed: …rutas de archivo de tu dispositivo… / …en tu dispositivo…
findings.reason: The English source says 'device' in both keys and glossary §2 fixes device→dispositivo (the es guide repeats 'dispositivo' as settled), while 'equipo' is the glossary's rendering of team — and welcome.body.1 uses 'un equipo de agentes' for exactly that, so these two keys read as 'your team' beside a team sentence.

findings.current: Cualquier archivo HTML que abras se renderiza dinámicamente en un iframe. Cualquier archivo Markdown que abras se muestra en un visor Markdown completo…
findings.proposed: Cualquier archivo HTML que abras se muestra dinámicamente en un iframe.
findings.reason: Two renderings of the same English verb 'rendered' sit in adjacent sentences ('se renderiza' / 'se muestra'); 'renderizar' is an untracked dev calque (not on the es kept-English list) and no sibling product-copy string uses it, so the first sentence should follow the second.

findings.current: …burbujas de mensaje y un cuadro de redacción / …pegar imágenes en el campo de chat…
findings.proposed: …burbujas de mensaje y un cuadro de mensaje / …pegar imágenes en el cuadro de mensaje…
findings.reason: The message box carries three different names in es: 'cuadro de redacción' and 'campo de chat' here, versus the settled 'cuadro de mensaje' in ui.canvas.create_file_dialog… ('desde el cuadro de mensaje') and ui.chat.pickers.destination_pickers…; one object, one term.

findings.proposed: Sube el agente al Hub de agentes
findings.reason: The locale's settled surface name is capitalised 'Hub de agentes' (six keys here plus ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub); the lowercase 'hub' is mirrored from a lowercase English source, which should be fixed at source too.

findings.current: Los modelos marcados como “Recomendado” funcionan bien con Local Operator.
findings.proposed: Se sabe que los modelos marcados como “Recomendado” funcionan bien con Local Operator.
findings.reason: English hedges with 'are known to work well'; the Spanish states it as a guarantee, which is a different claim about third-party models.

findings.current: …donde puedes organizarte, planificar e interactuar con tus agentes…
findings.proposed: …donde puedes organizar, planificar e interactuar con tus agentes…
findings.reason: The reflexive turns 'organize your files' into 'organize yourself'; the other two verbs in the same list are transitive, so the shift is audible.

findings.current: Cerrar el recorrido (19 characters against English 10, 1.9x)
findings.reason: The sidecar budgets this label at about 1.5x; it is the screen-reader-only name of the X button, so there is no visible overflow and no rendered check is needed — the shorter form still names the tour rather than the application.

findings.proposed: …usando lo que recuerda y el contexto…
findings.reason: 'sus memorias' is a word-for-word plural that reads as written memoirs in Spanish; the same namespace names agent memory correctly in agent_capabilities.body.1 ('tienen memoria'), so the plural here is the odd one out.

findings.current: …para saber cómo pedirse ayuda entre ellos en determinadas tareas.
findings.proposed: …para saber cómo sumar a otros agentes a determinadas tareas.
findings.reason: English 'how to tag each other in for certain tasks' describes bringing another agent into a task, not asking it for help; 'pedirse ayuda' narrows the described mechanism.

findings.current: Te damos la bienvenida a Local Operator (39 characters against English 25, 1.56x)
findings.proposed: no text change required; rendered check of the one-line heading, with 'Bienvenido a Local Operator' (27) as the shorter fallback if it wraps
findings.reason: The sidecar budgets a one-line heading at about 1.5x; this is the only visible title over budget, and the shorter form trades the gender-neutral greeting for fit — a decision for a rendered frame, not for this text-only audit.

source_defects_carried.carried: The doubled comma is produced by the join, not by the translation: the es fragments and the ' y ' before the '>' keycap are correct and cannot remove a comma that lives in the code span. UNRESOLVED STRUCTURAL SOURCE OBSERVATION for the owner.

first_audit_comparison.rule: Round 2 audits independently, then reconciles. Agreement is recorded as agreement, not as a source of findings; disagreement is stated with its reason.
agreed: ES-T2 (device→dispositivo in two keys) — independently re-derived as ES2-M2 from the glossary row and the English 'device'.
ES-T3 ('sus memorias') — re-derived as ES2-N5 but graded nit rather than minor: the meaning survives and only the register is odd.

ES-N3 (two nouns for the message box) — re-derived and strengthened as ES2-M4 using the settled sibling term 'cuadro de mensaje'; graded minor because it is cross-catalogue drift, not just an in-namespace variant.
ES-N4 (width risks) — re-derived in part: welcome.title is carried as ES2-N7 (rendered-check flag).
not_adopted: ES-T1 proposed changing the es quote to 'Nueva tarea programada'. Rejected as a translator fix: the English source quotes the same stale label, so a Spanish-only edit would diverge from English. Carried as source defect S2 instead.

ES-N1 ('la Paleta de comandos' → lowercase). Not adopted as a finding: the sibling evidence is genuinely mixed — the surface label is capitalised in ui.command_palette.command_palette ('Paleta de comandos') and lowercase mid-sentence in ui.settings.shortcuts ('abre la paleta de comandos'). That is a product-wide style inconsistency to settle once, not a defect introduced here.
ES-N2 ('solicitudes potentes' → 'peticiones eficaces'). Not adopted: 'potente' is an ordinary Spanish adjective and the rendering is not a calque; the objection is preference, not correctness.

ES-N4's proposed fallbacks for action.next and welcome.title ('Seguir', 'Bienvenida a Local Operator'). Not adopted as text changes: 'Siguiente' is the canonical Spanish 'Next' and 'Seguir' would change the control's meaning; the welcome heading is flagged for a rendered frame instead.
